The amendments related to excluded occupations. ### Amendment text > *(1) Schedule 1, item 4, page 5 (line 10), before "different kinds of occupations", insert "subject to subsection (5A),".* > > *(2) Schedule 1, item 4, page 5 (after line 11), after subsection 140GB(5), insert:* > >> *(5A) None of the following kinds of occupations may be prescribed for the purposes of subparagraph (2)(c)(iii):* >> >>> *(a) trade workers;* >>> >>> *(b) machinery operators or drivers;* >>> >>> *(c) labourers.*
